title: Cocktail romantique
lyrics_plain:
Oh! my love, my darling
I've hungered for your touch
along, lonely time
And time, goes by so slowly
and time, can do so much
Are you still mine?
I need your love, I, I need your love
God speed your love to me
Only you, can make all this world seems bright
Only you, can make the darkness bright
Only you and you alone
Can thrill me like you do
and fill my heart with love for only you
OnOnly you can make all this change in me
For it's true, you are my destiny
When you hold my hand
I understand the magic that you do
You're my dream come true, my one and only you
I can't stop lovin' you
I've made up my mind
To live in memory all the lonesome times
I can't stop wanting you
It's useless to say
So I'll just live my life on dreams of yesterday
When a man loves a woman
Can't keep his mind on nothing else
He'd treat the world
for the good things he has found
If she's bad, he can't see it
She can do no wrong
Turn his back on his best friend
if he put it down
When a man loves a woman
Spend his very last dime
Try to hold on to what he needs
He'd give up all of his comforts
and sleep out in the rain
if she says that's the way it ought to be
We skipped the light fandango
Turning cart wheels across the floor
I was feeling kind of seasick
The crowd called out for more
The room was humming harder
As the ceiling flew away
When we called out for another drink
The waiter brought a tray
And so it was later
As the miller told his tale
That her face at first just ghostly
Turned a whiter shade of pale
When I need you, I just close my eyes
and I'm with you
And all that I saw want to give you
It's only a heartbeat away
When I need love, I hold out my hands
then I touch love
I never knew there was so much love
keepin' me warm night and day
When I need love, I hold out my hands
then I touch love
I never knew there was so much love
Keepin' me warm night and day
Mem'ries, light the corners of my life
Misty water colored mem'ries
of the way we were
Scattered pictures of the smiles we left behind
Smiles we gave to one another
for the way we were
Oh! my love, my darling
I've hungered for your touch
along, lonely time
And time, goes by so slowly
and time, can do so much
Are you still mine?
I need your love, I, I need your love
God speed your love to me
